replies.author: PM_ME_PICS_OF_UR_PS3
replies.body: Nope, I had ai generate design sheets for each area; told it exactly how I want it to look; made multiple iterations to get it the way I wanted it to look; what I did copy from inside was the design of the boy and his running; which I’ll have to change out, but this will never be a commercial release anyhow

replies.author: minicoman
replies.body: Commercial or not, If you ever want to make something more original its important to understand what exactly inspires you about a project and try to differentiate vs just ripping it off. Example: the gloomy atmosphere, simple faceless characters, the 2.5d perspective, or how the environment can also tell a story by just walking by it. Take atleast one of those things, Add a bit of your life experiences and really make it your own and you'll have something a bit more original. After all The Ai only does what ever you tell it to.

replies.author: PM_ME_PICS_OF_UR_PS3
